browser.name: Google Chrome
browser.method: Playwright on localhost; each 120x80 element is captured as a Chrome screenshot and RGBA values are read back from those PNG bytes in Chrome.

assets.description: Opaque red left half and blue right half; the data URI is embedded for replay.
Opaque #16a085 pixel, repeated as a 0.25px by 0.25px background.

interpretation.raster: The 40x20 asset has opaque red pixels in x=0..19 and blue pixels in x=20..39. The additional asset is a single opaque #16a085 pixel.
interpretation.sizing: Cases cover explicit dimensions, one auto axis, percentage dimensions, independent stretching, zero width, and a 0.25px by 0.25px background repeated across the element. Computed longhands preserve Chrome values.
interpretation.positionsAndRepeat: Position cases include center, right, and bottom anchoring; repeat cases include repeat-x, repeat-y, and repeat in both axes.
interpretation.alphaComposition: The final case places a half-alpha green gradient over the raster image; sampled output is recorded from the Chrome screenshot PNG.
interpretation.screenshotPixels: Pixel RGBA values come from the actual PNG bytes returned by locator.screenshot(); no manually calculated pixel values are used as expected results.
interpretation.sampling: The normal-size raster samples avoid principal image, tile, and red/blue split boundaries. The tiny repeat case uses the same 96 integer device-pixel locations to capture the rendered texture after many subpixel tiles contribute to each sample.
